info.title: Aisenhub Account API
info.description: Account API contract. Runtime routes are defined in supabase/functions/account-api/index.ts.

get.description: Returns the fixed product catalog and platform-specific availability. Provider checkout is not enabled in this phase.
Recovers a durable Checkout intent by the authenticated account's Idempotency-Key after an unknown create response. This endpoint never creates a new Checkout.

post.description: Creates or recovers a server-priced checkout intent. Checkout remains closed until a verified provider mapping is configured.

get.description: Streams the approved immutable Version from private Storage. Only a completed stream records download_completed.

post.description: Delivers the approved Version bytes to the Consumer BFF. apply_delivery_completed proves central delivery only, not target-platform business success. Repeated Idempotency-Key values deduplicate the usage fact.

ReauthAccessToken.name: X-Reauth-Access-Token
ReauthAccessToken.description: Short-lived server-to-server token for the independently verified email-auth event. Never returned to the browser.

RecentAuthProof.name: X-Recent-Auth-Proof
RecentAuthProof.description: Opaque server-issued proof bound to the current account session.

NoStore.description: V1 responses are not shared or ISR cached.

SubscriptionProducts.description: Fixed subscription products with platform availability and explicit purchase readiness.

RecentAuthProof.description: Recent-auth proof bound to the original account session.

SubscriptionCheckout.description: Checkout intent status and immutable price snapshot.

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request exceeds the bounded body or byte limit.

NotFound.description: Resource not found without cross-tenant existence disclosure.

Conflict.description: State, idempotency, quota or content conflict.

RateLimited.description: Rate limited; response includes Retry-After when available.
